info.name: Reloop Mixtour Pro
info.author: openDJ
info.description: Reloop Mixtour Pro, written for openDJ from the MIDI notes djay Pro's built-in mapping uses. Four decks, eight pad modes and STEMS EQ.

control.description: BROWSE: turn to move through the list
SHIFT + BROWSE: turn to move through the sidebar
BROWSE press: open the folder or load the track
CUE MIX: cue or main in the headphones
FX left arrow: less of the effects
FX right arrow: more of the effects
IN-OUT-EX: loop in, loop out, out of the loop, deck 1
SHIFT + IN-OUT-EX: auto loop on or off, deck 1
SHIFT + SYNC: match the key, deck 1
SHIFT + PLAY: bend the tempo up, deck 1
SHIFT + CUE: bend the tempo down, deck 1
MODE + CUE: key down a semitone, deck 1
MODE + PLAY: key up a semitone, deck 1
MODE + IN-OUT-EX: halve the loop, deck 1
MODE + SYNC: double the loop, deck 1
MODE + BROWSE: move through the track a beat at a time, deck 1
STEMS EQ: the EQ knobs set stem volumes, deck 1
MODE + pad 1: HOT CUE pad mode, deck 1
MODE + pad 2: BOUNCE LOOP pad mode, deck 1
MODE + pad 3: PITCH CUE pad mode, deck 1
MODE + pad 4: INSTANT FX pad mode, deck 1
MODE + pad 5: AUTO LOOP pad mode, deck 1
MODE + pad 6: SAMPLER pad mode, deck 1
MODE + pad 7: SAVED LOOPS pad mode, deck 1
MODE + pad 8: NEURAL MIX pad mode, deck 1
FX paddle: effects on (up) or on while held (down), deck 1
SHIFT + FX left arrow: previous effect, deck 1
SHIFT + FX right arrow: next effect, deck 1
